resumeText:
Mohammed Faizan | Hyderabad, Telangana | faizan.cloud@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering, Muffakham Jah College of Engineering and Technology, Hyderabad (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 7.9/10

INTERNSHIP
Cloud Support Intern, Deccan Hosting Solutions, Hyderabad (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025, 8 weeks)
- Launched and maintained Ubuntu Linux EC2 instances on AWS for two client staging websites.
- Wrote a Bash script to compress Nginx logs and copy them to an S3 bucket every night using cron.
- Updated runbooks for restarting web servers after the senior engineer's walkthrough.

PROJECTS
- Three-tier web app on AWS (personal): Created a custom VPC with public and private subnets, a NAT gateway and route tables for a Flask app and MySQL database.
- Containerised college event portal (academic, Cloud Computing course): Containerised the Node.js event portal with Docker and ran it on a single EC2 instance with Docker Compose.
- Static portfolio site: Hosted my portfolio on S3 with CloudFront.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2025)
- Coursework: Computer Networks, Operating Systems, Cloud Computing, DBMS

SKILLS
AWS (EC2, S3, VPC, CloudWatch), Linux, Bash, Docker, Terraform (basics), Git, Python basics, Nginx

ACTIVITIES
- AWS Cloud Club campus captain, hosted three hands-on workshops
- Volunteer, college blood donation drive
